general.name: UniFi Endpoint [Win]
general.description:
Installs, updates, reinstalls or uninstalls UniFi Endpoint silently from Ubiquiti's signed MSI or attached MSI.
Source: https://github.com/TechCollective/DattoRMM_Components/tree/main/Applications/unifi-endpoint-win

variables.name: usrSource
variables.description: Auto = latest MSI from Ubiquiti, falling back to an attached MSI. Download = latest MSI. Attached = attachment only, no network.

variables.name: uiEndpointDomain
variables.description: UniFi organization domain (ORG_DOMAIN). Set per site; leave blank here.

variables.name: usrLaunchAtStartup
variables.description: Launch the app when a user signs in.

variables.name: usrCheckUpdate
variables.description: The app's own update check. If users will be local admins change to 'Yes'.

variables.name: usrConnectWiFi
variables.description: Connect to the assigned Wi-Fi at startup.

variables.name: usrConnectVpn
variables.description: Connect to the assigned VPN at startup.

variables.name: usrEnforceConfig
variables.description: true = lock the settings above so users cannot change them.

variables.name: usrKeepExistingSettings
variables.description: On an update, keep the device's existing domain/startup/VPN/Wi-Fi/lock settings instead of the values above.

variables.name: usrInstallerName
variables.description: File name of an attached MSI (used only as the fallback). Bare .msi name, no path.

variables.name: usrExtraMsiArgs
variables.description: Extra UPPERCASE_PROPERTY=value pairs, space separated. Anything else fails the job.
